title: Strict perfectness of the explicit bounded affine-resolution complex
statement: For a scheme Y, affine open U, and a nonnegative chain complex K over Γ(Y,U), assume every term is finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module] and K_n is zero for n > r. The explicit associated cochain complex [def-affine-finite-free-model-complex] is strictly perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] on the localized site over U. No resolving sheaf or quasi-isomorphism is needed.
